name: video-game-engine
description: 3D game engine for the browser with multiplayer support

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/shared-contracts run build && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:server:prod: npm --prefix packages/shared-contracts run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:client:prod: npm --prefix packages/shared-contracts run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix server run type-check && npm --prefix client run type-check
scripts.validate:hardening: npm run validate:authority && npm run validate:replay && npm run validate:streaming && npm run validate:scale && npm run validate:tooling && npm run validate:release && npm run validate:drift-bomb
scripts.test: npm run validate:hardening && vitest run --config test/vitest.config.ts
